transcript.text: Samsung WW90T534DAW keeps coming up with 4C after a couple of minutes. Drum is dry. Any ideas before I call someone out?

4C on your Samsung means: Water supply issue - little or no water entering (tap/pressure/inlet mesh/hose). From what you have described, the most likely cause is power-cycle / reset. Next: Power-cycle the machine to clear a transient glitch. Let me know what you find.
Ok, I'll switch it off at the wall and turn it back on. Anything else worth checking while I do that? Also, there was no water sound when it should be filling, just a faint buzz from the back.

Since you have not specified what task "that" refers to, I cannot provide relevant checks. Please clarify which specific repair or inspection step you are currently performing so I can advise appropriately. From what you have described, the most likely cause is blocked inlet mesh / filter. Check the tap the fill hose connects to is turned fully on, and that the hose behind the machine isn't kinked or squashed against the wall. Was the tap fully on and the hose clear, did you find it off or kinked (and sort it), or is the hose itself damaged?
Tap was open, I turned it fully anticlockwise anyway and no change. Hose isn't kinked either. Still 4C.

From what you have described, the most likely cause is a blocked inlet mesh filter. Where the fill hose screws onto the back of the machine there's a small mesh filter that can block with grit or scale. Unscrew the hose at the machine end and look into the inlet. Was the mesh blocked (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
Mesh filter was blocked, full of grey grit and limescale bits. I've cleaned it and refitted the hose, and now it fills normally and the 4C has gone.
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
